author: Valve
algorithm: VRF 5564866c7f2a6b2ee54a9195b7963147e24da94e CableMeshBuilder, BasicMovement and RopeSpringConstraint; offline only
constraintPassBasis: Inferred: one effective pass fits 20 samples across four native reference cables within one pixel; VRF default three does not

runtime.radiusEncoding: COLOR_0.r = radius / 0.0254; runtime restores white tint

limitations: Settling follows the inspected VRF reconstruction, not a native engine particle snapshot; exact native centerline parity remains unverified.

The native F_CLAMP_MIN_RADIUS flag is implemented with an inferred 0.75-pixel radial floor; its exact engine constant is unverified. Existing resampled ambient probes and Three PBR still approximate native cable lighting.
All authored endpoints, radii, slack, spacing and pin flags are retained; the native constant material needs no runtime texture.
